datasets.purpose: Acute Food Insecurity Classifications data in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected acute food insecurity classification data on a regular monthly schedule in 2011, assessing food security conditions across Malawi's administrative divisions using standardized classification scales and scenarios. The data represents post-assessment situational classifications reflecting population vulnerability to food insecurity.
